phase_policies.applies_when: Early game (~3 min) with ground-oriented posture, heavy economy and tech, possible Reaper cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see more of the opponent's army composition or if they apply pressure; adjust production and tech accordingly.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, maintain production, and keep defense solid.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing ground forces and economy while maintaining defensive structures; increase economy and continue technology upgrades; keep production steady.
phase_policies.title: Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single tech path or neglect scouting for early pressure; avoid excessive production without economy support.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early midgame (~5-6 min) with ground-oriented posture, heavy production and tech, possible Marine/Reaper cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have a clear read on the opponent's composition or if they attempt an aggressive move.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on defensive ground strength, economy, and tech; expand cautiously.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army with Siege Tanks for defense; increase economy and production; continue tech; consider expansion if safe.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army with Siege Tanks
phase_policies.veto: Do not push into fortified positions without Siege Tank support; avoid neglecting defense while expanding.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame (~7-9 min) with ground-oriented posture, heavy production and tech, possible Siege Tank/Reaper/Hellion/Raven cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech direction or if they commit to a specific composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance ground and air, expand, and keep tech advancing.
phase_policies.target: Increase air presence and strengthen ground forces; continue expanding and increasing economy and technology; maintain production.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army with Air Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to air without scouting opponent's anti-air; avoid neglecting ground defense while teching.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late midgame (~10 min) with ground-oriented posture, heavy production and tech, possible Marine/Reaper/Marauder/Hellion cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's late-game composition or if they attempt a major push.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Keep a strong ground core, expand, and adapt to opponent's tech.
phase_policies.target: Maintain a versatile ground army; increase economy and production; continue tech; consider expansion and defense.
phase_policies.title: Versatile Ground Army
phase_policies.veto: Do not get into a siege war without mobility; avoid neglecting scouting for tech switches.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
